credits.title: The Ballad from Wednesday to Thursday
credits.overview: During the course of a single night, various people cross paths in the pubs, bars, and hookah lounges of Cologne. The issues that all of Germany is talking about are put on the table: the patriarchy, the Middle East conflict, rising rents, and whether Jesus would still buy everyone drinks today. credits.title: Harika
credits.overview: In a small town, a harmless prank by children causes turmoil in the community. Two boys hit Arkan's Chihuahua, the owner of a boxing gym, with a water balloon. Was the dog hurt? A harmless rumor grows and puts the community to the test.
